purpose: Replay set for the whitespace radar: fixed topics, frozen labels, machine-checkable accuracy. Not an independent test set - it is the regression guard for the adjudication rule (see docs/whitespace_radar/README.md §6).

sampling.method: random.Random(seed).sample over the sorted doc_id list of pool kind=doc, then re-sorted by doc_id

label_protocol.covered: topic authored by reading the sampled doc; it must literally share >= 2 content phrases (>=2 CJK chars or >=3 latin chars) with that doc's text, verified by the adjudicator's literal probe test
label_protocol.partial: topic has a novel core (all core phrases absent from every pool doc) but at least one adjacent generic phrase exists, so the honest answer is 'narrow the claim', not 'blank'
label_protocol.blank: every discriminative probe (4-char CJK window / latin token with df/N <= 0.02) is machine-verified absent, i.e. each probe's df == 0 over all pool docs
